split_reasoning: This is one cross-cutting activity of following dangerous-goods safety procedures during transport.

parts.text: Follow required safety procedures when transporting dangerous goods.
parts.type_reasoning: The procedures are applied in hands-on transport work rather than producing a separate deliverable.

notes: Safety procedures vary by cargo and can be embedded in driving, securing loads, inspection and documentation.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Walk around the tractor and trailer to inspect brakes, tires, lights, couplings and safety and emergency equipment.
parts.type_reasoning: A hands-on walk-around inspection done at the truck, away from a computer.

notes: The written pre-trip or post-trip report is covered under 10637 and 10644.

split_reasoning: Two different records: the hours-of-service log and the vehicle service or repair status record.

parts.text: Keep the daily hours-of-service log (duty status changes, certify the day's record).
parts.type_reasoning: Each day's log is a regulated record that carriers and inspectors rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: One log is certified per driver per day.
parts.end: day's log reviewed, edited and certified
parts.checked_by: motor carrier compliance staff and DOT roadside or audit inspectors

parts.text: Record the vehicle's service and repair status in the inspection report after each trip.
parts.type_reasoning: Each report goes to maintenance, who rely on it.
parts.unit_reasoning: Reports are filed per vehicle per trip or day.
parts.work_item: one vehicle condition report (pre- or post-trip) filed
parts.start: end of the day's driving or inspection complete
parts.end: report signed and submitted to the carrier

notes: Service and repair status logs may be separate from the daily inspection report in some fleets.

split_reasoning: One activity: getting proof of delivery and any payment, done at the dock with the receiver present.

parts.text: Get the receiver's signature on the delivery receipt and collect payment when required, at the delivery point.
parts.type_reasoning: The receiver is present and waiting while the signature and payment are handled.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each delivery stop is closed out in one handover.
parts.work_item: one delivery receipt signed and any payment collected at the stop
parts.end: signed receipt (and payment) obtained, copy retained
parts.checked_by: the receiver, and the carrier's billing office

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Back the truck into a loading or unloading position, following the dock crew's signals and checking trailer and equipment alignment.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on vehicle maneuvering at the dock.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Drive a tractor-trailer or heavy truck over the route to transport and deliver the load.
parts.type_reasoning: Driving is hands-on work with no document produced.

notes: Driving is the bulk of the job; other statements are mostly sub-activities.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Secure cargo on the trailer using ropes, blocks, chains, binders or covers.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on physical work at the trailer.

split_reasoning: Reading a bill of lading to understand the assignment is one activity.

parts.text: Read the bill of lading to determine assignment details.
parts.type_reasoning: Reading the existing document for the driver's own understanding does not itself produce a separate item for others to check.

notes: Checking documentation for completeness and accuracy is separately covered by task 20693.

split_reasoning: Two kinds of report: routine defect and damage reports, and rarer incident reports for accidents or violations.

parts.text: Report vehicle defects or damage to the carrier's maintenance or dispatch.
parts.type_reasoning: Each report starts a repair or is logged by maintenance.
parts.unit_reasoning: Defects are reported one at a time or in the daily inspection report.
parts.work_item: one defect or damage report submitted
parts.end: report submitted and acknowledged by maintenance

parts.text: File an accident or traffic-violation report with the carrier.
parts.type_reasoning: Each incident produces a report that safety and insurance staff rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Incidents are reported one at a time.
parts.work_item: one accident or violation report filed
parts.start: incident occurs and scene is safe
parts.end: report filed with the carrier (and police or insurer as needed)

split_reasoning: One activity: working out the route for a trip.

parts.text: Read maps or route atlases to work out the route for a delivery.
parts.type_reasoning: The route is something the dispatcher and customer rely on for delivery on time, though the driver mostly uses it alone.
parts.unit_reasoning: One route is worked out per trip.
parts.end: route chosen and ready to drive
parts.checked_by: the driver and dispatcher (delivery on time)

notes: Borderline NO_DELIVERABLE; overlaps strongly with GPS route planning in 19923.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Couple or uncouple a trailer by setting jacks, connecting air and electrical lines and operating fifth-wheel locks.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on work at the truck and trailer.

split_reasoning: One activity: gathering and checking delivery instructions for a load.

parts.text: Collect and verify delivery instructions and the route for a load from dispatch, the customer or the receiver.
parts.type_reasoning: The verified instructions are relied on by the dispatcher and customer.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each load has its own instruction set.
parts.work_item: one load's delivery instructions collected and verified
parts.end: instructions and route confirmed with source

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Walk around and look inside the empty trailer after unloading to check for damage.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on inspection at the trailer.

notes: Any damage found is reported under 10644.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Crank trailer landing gear up or down to secure the trailer.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on physical work at the trailer.

notes: A sub-step of coupling and uncoupling (10646).

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Add oil, fuel or radiator fluid, make minor repairs and wash the truck.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on maintenance work away from a computer.

split_reasoning: Checking quantity and condition are components of the same inspection and inventory of goods to be moved.

parts.text: Inventory and inspect goods to be moved for quantity and condition.
parts.type_reasoning: Counting and inspecting the goods requires physical examination of the load.

notes: Any separate damage or discrepancy report is not specified by this target.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Remove debris from the loaded trailer.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on cleaning work at the trailer.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Carry out special cargo procedures such as checking refrigeration units or feeding and watering livestock.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on tending of the cargo and its equipment.

split_reasoning: One activity: instructing the people who load.

parts.text: Direct laborers who are packing goods and moving them onto the trailer.
parts.type_reasoning: The value is in the live direction of others and nothing a colleague could check is produced.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Install or remove tire chains, plow or grader blades, sanders or similar special equipment.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on mechanical work.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Make emergency roadside repairs such as changing tires or fitting bulbs, chains or spark plugs.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on repair work at the roadside.

split_reasoning: The listed systems and purposes are alternative uses of the same activity of operating auxiliary or idle-reduction power.

parts.text: Operate idle-reduction or auxiliary power equipment for the truck's power or climate needs.
parts.type_reasoning: The driver physically operates vehicle equipment rather than producing a separate deliverable.

split_reasoning: One activity: route planning or adjusting.

parts.text: Plan or adjust the route using GPS or fleet software in response to traffic, weather or closures, to save fuel.
parts.type_reasoning: Each change produces a revised route that the driver and dispatcher rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Route changes happen one at a time as conditions change.
parts.work_item: one route plan or adjustment made
parts.end: revised route set and ETA updated if needed

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Check on the trailer that cargo is still tied down and secure, at the start and at stops.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on inspection at the trailer.

split_reasoning: One activity: checking a load's papers.

parts.text: Check a load's shipping documents for completeness and accuracy before departing or delivering.
parts.type_reasoning: Carriers, shippers and inspectors rely on accurate paperwork.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each load has its own document set.
parts.end: documents confirmed complete or errors raised

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Drive to weigh stations and scales before and after loading and on the route as state rules require.
parts.type_reasoning: Driving and stopping at scales is hands-on work away from a computer.

split_reasoning: One activity: exchanging information with base using in-cab devices.

parts.text: Exchange status and problem messages with dispatch, supervisors or other drivers by in-cab computer, radio or phone.
parts.type_reasoning: Each exchange (check call, ETA update, problem report) is something dispatch acts on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Messages go one at a time.
parts.work_item: one status or problem message exchange with dispatch
parts.start: driver sends or receives a message
parts.end: message acknowledged and any action agreed

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Load or unload the truck by hand or with pallet jacks, hand trucks or lift gates.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on physical work.

split_reasoning: One physical activity with no split by kind of work.

parts.text: Wrap and secure goods with pads, paper, containers or straps.
parts.type_reasoning: Hands-on physical work.
